spec.studio_prompt: A modern dining chair measuring 46 cm wide, 55 cm deep, and 95 cm high. The chair features a tall, straight, fully upholstered rectangular backrest and a clean-lined padded seat, both finished in fine-weave short-pile charcoal grey velvet (#646161) with subtle light variations (#323030). The seat is supported by four slender, round, tapered legs in a smooth matte black finish (#323030), slightly angled outward for stability. Tailoring is minimal with crisp, tight piped edges and no tufting.
